tagline: Diversified energy solutions provider across Africa, Caribbean, and Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: Rubis demonstrates solid EBITDA growth at €772M (+7% YoY) supported by robust performance in energy distribution (fuels, LPG, bitumen) and acceleration of photovoltaic renewable energy, generating substantial operating cash flows.

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating result before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization.
kpis.description: EBITDA stands at €772M in 2025, up 7% year-over-year at constant EUR/USD exchange rate and constant hyperinflation, supported by solid operating performance.

kpis.name: Group Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit attributable to group shareholders.
kpis.description: Group net income reached €309M in 2025, advancing 19% (excluding divestiture gains), supported by solid operating performance and absence of foreign exchange losses.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (Capex)
kpis.explanation: Cash invested in physical assets such as infrastructure, equipment and facilities.
kpis.description: Total Capex stands at €376M in 2025, of which €248M financed with non-recourse debt, investments driven by energy distribution and photovoltaic projects.
kpis.signal: High Capex oriented toward energy distribution and renewable energy.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Rubis employs approximately 4,600 employees distributed across 45 countries in Africa, Caribbean and Europe.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount covering 45 countries across 3 continents.

kpis.name: Corporate Net Debt / EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Leverage ratio measuring net debt relative to EBITDA, an indicator of repayment capacity.
kpis.description: Corporate net financial debt stands at €602M, representing 0.9x EBITDA, down 0.4x versus December 2024, reflecting a solid capital structure.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend in euros distributed per share to shareholders.
kpis.description: 2025 dividend of €2.07 per share, up 6%, marking the 30th consecutive year of increase with 2015-2025 CAGR of 2.07%.

kpis.name: Photosol Photovoltaic Production Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in operating assets and renewable electricity production.
kpis.description: In 2025, operating assets increased 21% and electricity production increased 21%, with a secured portfolio of 1.4 GWc (+30% YoY) and Power EBITDA of €47M (+32% YoY).

kpis.name: Bitumen Volume Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in bitumen volumes distributed, reflecting expansion in Africa.
kpis.description: Bitumen showed 28% volume growth and 18% gross margin growth in 2025, driven by expansion in Africa (Angola, Libya) and initial steps in Europe (Antwerp).
kpis.signal: Strong bitumen momentum with African expansion.

kpis.name: Fuel Distribution Performance
kpis.explanation: Growth in volumes and margins in fuel distribution.
kpis.description: Caribbean and Africa showed 4% volume growth and 5% gross margin growth in 2025, driven by commercial momentum in Guyana, Haiti and East Africa.
kpis.signal: Sustained fuel growth in Caribbean and Africa.

kpis.name: LPG Distribution Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in volumes and margins in LPG distribution, a transition energy.
kpis.description: Europe and Africa showed 2% volume growth and 3% gross margin growth for LPG in 2025, driven by activities in France, Spain and South Africa.
kpis.signal: LPG growing steadily as a transition energy.

ai_positioning.summary: Rubis does not mention any AI-related initiatives in its recent financial or operational documents. The company focuses on energy distribution (fuels, LPG, bitumen) and photovoltaic renewable energy.
evidence: No mention of AI, machine learning or cognitive technologies
Strategic focus on energy distribution, bitumen and photovoltaic solar projects
Complete absence of references to advanced automation tools or predictive analytics
